tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page canvas and the ground behind panes. Text on it: text, muted, faint (all pass 4.5:1). Source: studio-app tokens.css --bg.

tokens.name: rail
tokens.usage: Left navigation rail ground. Text on it: text, muted.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: Pane, card and chart surface, one step above bg. Text on it: text, muted, faint.

tokens.name: hover
tokens.usage: Hover wash on rows, tabs and buttons; also the stripe in the empty-state hatch.

tokens.name: selected
tokens.usage: Selected row, progress-bar track. Text on it: text, muted.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline between rows inside a pane or card. Translucent: never a text colour.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Pane and button outline, tab-list underline. Translucent: never a text colour.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text, values, and the inverted primary-button fill. On bg, raised, rail, hover, selected.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: labels, descriptions, hints. On bg, raised, rail, hover, selected.

tokens.name: faint
tokens.usage: Tertiary text and disabled controls (disabled also gets a dashed border). On bg, raised, rail.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: Signal orange as TEXT: failure words, the Could-not-be-tested pill, tab badges. State only. On bg, raised.

tokens.name: signal-graphic
tokens.usage: Signal orange as a MARK (lines, glyph fills, verdict left rule). Same value as signal in dark. Needs 3:1.

tokens.name: stroke
tokens.usage: Chart axis and glyph strokes that carry meaning. Needs 3:1 on bg and raised.

tokens.name: grid
tokens.usage: Chart gridlines. Decorative, no contrast requirement.

tokens.name: notice-error-bg
tokens.usage: Ground of the inline error notice.

tokens.name: ramp-0
tokens.usage: Low end of the lineage score ramp (lowest score).

tokens.name: ramp-1
tokens.usage: High end of the lineage score ramp (best score).

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Sign role colour on focal numbers only (value text, never a fill) and legacy success mark. sign-negative under the default red-up convention, sign-positive under green-up (a Settings switch). Always paired with a leading + or minus glyph. On bg, raised.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Legacy analysis-page state colour: caution. Same restriction as ok.

tokens.name: err
tokens.usage: Sign role colour on focal numbers only (value text, never a fill) and legacy error text. sign-positive under the default red-up convention, sign-negative under green-up (a Settings switch). Always paired with a leading + or minus glyph. On bg, raised.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Alias for tools that need a primary colour: the primary action is the inverted fill, text on bg, never an orange fill.

families.sans: 'Inter Variable', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', 'Noto Sans SC', system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Existing token. Reserved: one statement on the home page or a full-page empty state. Not used on workbench or library pages.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Existing token, currently unused by the workbench pages; kept so nothing breaks. Candidate to merge into headline (owner decision).

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: PROPOSED. The page header title: the one anchor of hierarchy on every page. Text on bg or raised.

styles.name: section
styles.usage: Existing. Section and card headings, pane titles. Text on raised.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Existing. Evidence sentences, form text, table text. Text on raised, muted for secondary.
styles.sample: The mean rank IC clears the noise frontier.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Existing. Descriptions, status lines, hints, button text in dense rows.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: PROPOSED formalisation of the 11px already used by fact and stat labels. Metric labels; set in muted, never in a state colour.

styles.name: value
styles.usage: Numbers and ids in metric cells, fact chips and tables. Tabular, in text on raised.

styles.name: value-focal
styles.usage: PROPOSED. The single headline number of a card or of the run bar; at most one per card. Text on raised.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: 4px baseline step: gap between tightly grouped items (tab list, action row).

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: 8px: gap inside a control group, pane-head padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: 12px: pane body padding and gap between cards (the main rhythm).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: 16px: gap between sections in a tab panel, card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Larger steps for page-level separation; do not use inside dense panes.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Larger steps for page-level separation; do not use inside dense panes.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Larger steps for page-level separation; do not use inside dense panes.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Larger steps for page-level separation; do not use inside dense panes.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, segmented toggle, panes, chart cards and chips. The smaller radius the owner chose over rounded floating cards.

tokens.name: radius-float
tokens.usage: Floating layers only: menus, popovers, dialogs.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Minimum height of a button in a dense action row.

tokens.name: pane-head-height
tokens.usage: Minimum height of a pane head row (tabs and actions).

tokens.name: page-max-width
tokens.usage: Maximum width of the workbench shell; content is centred beyond it.

tokens.name: pane-left-min
tokens.usage: Minimum width of the left (editor) pane; columns default to 40fr / 60fr.
